Website Builder

Edit your own website in place — words, pictures, links, buttons and design — and publish when you are ready. No code, no rebuild, and your existing site stays exactly as it was designed.

Every product page here answers the same three questions: what it does, how you get access, and how to use it. The documentation is part of the product, not an afterthought — when the software changes, the page changes with it.

Already on a Dakyworld retainer? Every product here is included at no extra cost — set up, connected and supported as part of the partnership you already have. On its own, the Website Builder is GHS 300 per month, with no setup fee.

What a product means here

Built for use, not for show.

A product earns its place on this page by being something Dakyworld already depends on.

01

We use it ourselves first

Nothing reaches this page as a concept. The Website Builder was built because updating client websites by hand was the slowest part of a monthly partnership, and it ran on our own site before it ran on anyone else's.

02

It says what it cannot do

Each product states its limits in plain terms before you commit to it. The Website Builder will tell you, page by page, what you can edit yourself, what needs a developer, and what it cannot carry at all.

03

The documentation stays current

A guide that describes last year's software is worse than no guide. When a product changes in a way that affects how you use it, its setup guide and documentation are updated in the same piece of work.

04

You keep what is yours

Your domain, your website's source, your content and your data remain yours. Access we are given can be narrowed or withdrawn by you at any time, without asking us.

Getting access

Products are set up with you, not sold at you.

Every product is currently onboarded by Dakyworld: we check your website works with it, connect it, and show you round before you are left with it. That takes one conversation.
